pages.text: $(bold)Mana Surge$() (default trait of all four $(bold)Wizard Set$() pieces, $(bold)unleveled$())$(br2)Active as long as you wear $(bold)any single piece$() carrying this trait, and it $(bold)stacks per piece$().$(br2)Per piece:$(li)Iron's Spells $(bold)max mana +125$()$(li)$(bold)spell power +5%$()$(li)$(bold)spell damage +7%$()

$(bold)Wearing all four$() gives $(bold)+500 mana / +20% spell power / +28% spell damage$().$(br2)Removing a piece removes its share - $(bold)recalculated once per second$(), with no relog and no reload needed.$(br2)$(italic)(Below four pieces the bonuses scale linearly with the actual count.)$()

$(bold)Spell inscribing$(): every wizard armor piece with this trait carries $(bold)one spell slot$().$(br2)The Iron's Spellbooks $(bold)Arcane Anvil$() only accepts items that already are spell containers, so this set is what lets you inscribe a $(bold)scroll$() spell onto your armor.$(br2)One spell per piece, $(bold)independent of each other$().

$(bold)Removing the trait removes this$(): the effect follows the $(bold)trait$(), not the item.$(br2)Wash Mana Surge off with a $(l:trait_overview)modifier crystal$() and that piece loses both its bonuses and its spell slot.$(br2)$(italic)It is likewise inactive while the armor is broken (durability exhausted), and comes back once repaired.$()
